prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young man dressed in all black—fitted t-shirt, slim pants, and sneakers—performs a dynamic contemporary dance move on a sunlit, palm-lined promenade. He is captured mid-motion, lying on his side with one arm extended gracefully above his head and the other supporting his body, his face turned upward in a moment of expressive intensity. The promenade stretches into the distance, flanked by tall, evenly spaced palm trees and a row of parked cars on the right, with bicycles and benches on the left. The background features a clear blue sky and a hint of modern city architecture, evoking a coastal urban setting. The color palette is bright and natural, dominated by warm sunlight, soft shadows, and the cool tones of the pavement and sky. The composition uses a wide-angle lens and a low camera angle, emphasizing the dancer’s form against the strong linear perspective of the receding walkway. The overall style is cinematic and vibrant, with crisp focus on the subject and a sense of movement and energy frozen in time.
